visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-opening hero with heading, intro text and CTAs beside a three-image collage
visualCharacteristics.description: Fixed side-by-side layout of two different contents (text + CTAs vs. 3-image collage) that never wraps into a grid; images are inline, not a background, so not hero.

contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: (1) H1, paragraph, primary and secondary CTA links; (2) two or more images forming the collage
contentPattern.source: Hero intro with image collage (#main-content > header.section.secondary-section)
rows: Column 1: H1, paragraph, links 'See case' (primary) and 'All stories' (secondary)

usage: Top-of-page intro where text and CTAs sit beside several inline photos.
reuseGuidance: Use when the images are inline content, not a background. For a single background photo use hero-overlay-card.
